svg.title: Musashi Ken — The Drawn Blade. Draft 1 / Musashi Ken classification / forked tree.
svg.desc: 8 skills, 4 purchases, one Advanced Art maximum. Drawn Steel forks into Single Stroke then Cut of No Return, or Second Sword then Two Heavens as One. Reading the Field forks into Unbroken Guard then Victory in the Sheath. No paths converge. Bonuses affect existing supported tags on Musashi Ken jutsu (bloodline-keyed classification, proposed extension).

BUFF","adverse":false,"base":1.0,"gain":0,"final":1.0,"calculation":"static","supported":false,"capped_at_100":false}],"advanced_arts":["Victory in the Sheath"]}],"narrow_kit_exception":"Eight nodes and three Advanced Arts rather than ten and four. The kit has three supported tags on six rows (Increase Damage Given x3, Damage x2, Decrease Damage Taken x1); Iaijutsu's move row is unsupported. Drawn Steel forks into a damage route (Single Stroke \u2192 Cut of No Return, +6 with Reading the Field, the two-row Damage guardrail) and a tempo route (Second Sword \u2192 Two Heavens as One, +6 on three self rows that can stack). Decrease Damage Taken is one row, so Reading the Field runs a single chain (Unbroken Guard \u2192 Victory in the Sheath, 35\u219245%, the Taiyo Kami +10 shape); a fourth Advanced Art would need a second branch under Reading the Field that twins Single Stroke or Second Sword on the same rows, or a guard capstone past +10, and Draft 1 declines both so that each route is the only way to its tag maximum. Because the guard side has three nodes, every legal 4 BP build contains Drawn Steel; a mirrored layout only moves the universal node to the other root. Three distinct complete builds exist (Burst, Tempo, Guard); Burst and Tempo each have two fourth-purchase choices, Guard's fourth purchase is always Drawn Steel. 8 legal full allocations, 7 non-dominated, every node in at least one.","design_notes":["Node split: 2 Foundations, 3 Hidden Arts, 3 Advanced Arts. Drawn Steel (IDG +2 on all three self rows) forks into Single Stroke \u2192 Cut of No Return (Damage +2/+3) and Second Sword \u2192 Two Heavens as One (IDG +2, then IDG +2 with DDT +2). Reading the Field (DDT +2 on Heiho, Damage +1 on both strikes) runs one chain through Unbroken Guard \u2192 Victory in the Sheath (DDT +3, then DDT +5 with IDG +2). Every Advanced Art is 3 BP deep; two cost 5 BP under the shared root or 6 BP across roots.","Flats by coverage: Damage reaches two 38-power rows, so the route totals +6 (1+2+3; 38\u219244), the two-row guardrail Lycanthropy and Loup-Garou use; the +1 sits on the guard root so Burst's fourth purchase weighs power plus guard against tempo. IDG reaches three self rows that stack, so it is held to +6 (2+2+2; 35\u219241% per row), between Taiyo Kami's two-row +5 and the two-row +7 of Lycanthropy and Tenohira Musei. DDT is one row and takes 2+3+5 = +10 (35\u219245%), the Golden Mantle / Sovereign Sun shape.","Interactions: every supported row is element-less. The Bukijutsu filter on Heiho's and Iaijutsu's IDG is not binding: it matches every element-less hit of any stat type (weapons, basic attacks, non-elemental jutsu) and excludes only elemental Nin/Gen/Tai hits; Iaido's IDG and Heiho's DDT list all four stat types and match every non-pierce hit. Each adds power/100 \u00d7 the staged base per hit; the 15% Bukijutsu IDG passive is bloodline-sourced and multiplies in its own stage. Pierce is untouched.","Delivery and uptime: Heiho is a 40 AP self cast, cooldown 5, so its 2-round IDG and DDT windows cover at most 2 of 5 rounds. Iaido (single target, range 4) and Iaijutsu (ground circle, range 5) cost 60 AP, cooldown 7. Iaijutsu's damage hits enemies on the tiles; its move row sorts last and carries the caster in, so its IDG arrives from the next round and only while standing there. Heiho plus Iaido cost 100 AP; cast together, two IDG rows overlap for 2 rounds (70% base, 82% on the tempo route).","Fourth purchases: Burst (01,02,03) takes Reading the Field (strikes 44, guard 37%) or Second Sword (strikes 43, buffs 39%); Tempo (01,04,05) takes Reading the Field (guard 39%, strikes 39) or Single Stroke (strikes 40, guard 37%); Guard (06,07,08) can only add Drawn Steel (buffs 39%). Hybrids 01,02,04,06 (strikes 41, buffs 39%, guard 37%) and 01,02,06,07 (strikes 41, guard 40%) are non-dominated; 01,04,06,07 is dominated by the Guard build. 8 full allocations, 7 non-dominated, every node in one.","Row-weighted value: the Tempo builds (01,02,04,05 and 01,04,05,06) and the Guard build (01,06,07,08) are the strongest full allocations at 24; Burst runs 20\u201322 and the weakest hybrid 17. Dai Kenja peaks at 24 on six rows, Lycanthropy at 20 on five, Taiyo Kami at 31 on nine. Lowest-value purchases are Unbroken Guard (+3 on one row) and Reading the Field (+2 on one row, +1 on two); both are the price of the kit's only defensive lever and neither gates anything that out-bids a sibling."],"risks":["Classification: no row carries an element, so the tree needs the proposed bloodline-keyed label (Musashi Ken); under the current resolver all 6 supported rows fall back to None, which also reaches every non-elemental row on any jutsu the player casts. Whether NORMAL/SPECIAL/EVENT jutsu collide is unverified (no non-bloodline catalog with effect rows in the repository).","Broad self amplification (user-owned value): Two Heavens as One puts all three IDG rows at 41% for 2 rounds; Heiho and Iaido cast in one round overlap for +12 points on every element-less or Bukijutsu non-pierce hit (weapons, basic attacks, normal jutsu), Iaijutsu's row is a conditional third, and the 15% passive stacks on top. +5 (Second Sword +1) or +7 (capstone IDG +3, no DDT) are the options.","Iaijutsu buff timing: the IDG row rides a ground circle (EMPTY_GROUND, friendly fire ALL); the move row sorts last and carries the caster in, so the buff lands from the following round and only while the caster stays on the tiles. Realized uptime can fall below the nominal 2 rounds, and whether allies in the circle also receive the buff was not verified (the dossier derives the recipient as self).","Universal opener: every legal full build contains Drawn Steel because the guard side has three nodes. Moving the tempo chain under Reading the Field only makes that root universal instead; on six rows and three tags the brief's preference for no mandatory opener cannot be met without a twinned Hidden Art.","Guard is one row at 40% uptime: Victory in the Sheath puts Heiho's DDT at 45% for 2 rounds per 5-round cooldown against every non-pierce hit of any stat type (pierce is applied after the modifiers). It stacks with other DDT sources and runs against the bloodline's own 5% IDT passive on Nin/Gen/Tai hits, which no node changes. +8 (capstone +3) is the lighter alternative to Taiyo Kami's +10.","Damage is formula-calculated (sqrt stat scaling on Bukijutsu / Speed, Strength) and then multiplied by the Bukijutsu IDG passive and any active buff, so +6 raw power is not a linear +6 damage. Both strikes cost 60 AP with cooldown 7, so each Damage row fires at most once per 7 rounds, and Cut of No Return is the lowest-weight capstone (+3 on two rows). No combat simulation was performed.","Unsupported rows and modes: Iaijutsu's move receives nothing; the bloodline passives (15% Bukijutsu IDG, 5% IDT, sealprevent) are not jutsu rows. Skill-tree and bloodline effects are skipped in ranked PvP / sparring at the pin. No hidden, item-gated, mode-restricted, adverse or ally-hazard rows exist in this kit."],"progression":{"currency":"Bloodright Point","abbreviation":"BP","acquired_with":"silver","acquisition_cap":4,"node_cost":1,"silver_price":null,"ownership_gate":"current bloodline","separate_from_normal_skill_points":true},"evaluation_level":25,"game_source_pin":"16498fd776fad9c91e4b84efed4380fe3a487050","snapshot":{"public_kit_snapshot":"2026-10-01T14:58:45.422376+00:00","hidden_kit_snapshot":"2026-09-30"},"audit":{"available_skills":8,"foundation_count":2,"hidden_art_count":3,"advanced_art_count":3,"bloodright_point_cap":4,"cost_per_skill":1,"maximum_advanced_arts":1,"minimum_two_advanced_cost":5,"maximum_parents_per_node":1,"maximum_depth":3,"legal_allocations_by_size":{"0":1,"1":2,"2":4,"3":7,"4":8},"full_budget_allocations":8,"non_dominated_full_allocations":7,"all_nodes_in_non_dominated_builds":true,"nodes_absent_from_non_dominated_builds":[],"maximum_tag_bonuses":{"damage":6,"increasedamagegiven":6,"decreasedamagetaken":10},"supported_rows_in_kit":6,"supported_rows_by_tag":{"damage":2,"decreasedamagetaken":1,"increasedamagegiven":3},"tags_targeted_by_tree":["damage","decreasedamagetaken","increasedamagegiven"],"supported_tags_in_kit_not_targeted":[],"revision":"Draft 1 / Musashi Ken classification / forked tree","source_snapshot":"2026-10-01T14:58:45.422376+00:00","limits":["Proposed potency classification behavior; not implemented or verified in the live engine.","All existing supported tags of Musashi Ken jutsu inherit Musashi Ken potency eligibility; original combat elements and target scopes stay intact.","Every matching row on a jutsu receives each matching modifier; repeated rows are counted separately.","Damage values are raw power, not final-damage percentages; percentage-valued tags are capped at 100.","Afterburn is an enemy debuff: for its existing duration, damage the target takes causes extra Afterburn damage at its percentage (60% cap per hit). It is not itself a damage instance; downstream instances were not simulated.","Unsupported tags (e.g. wound, shield, stun, pierce, absorb, poison, drain, summon) receive no bonuses.","No combat simulation. Budget and numerical non-dominance checks do not establish equal combat strength.","Main-tree effects, bloodline passives, equipment, AP, uptime and modifier delivery are outside this audit."]},"legal_full_budget_builds":[{"ids":["01","02","03","04"],"bonuses":{"damage":5,"increasedamagegiven":4}},{"ids":["01","02","03","06"],"bonuses":{"damage":6,"increasedamagegiven":2,"decreasedamagetaken":2}},{"ids":["01","02","04","05"],"bonuses":{"damage":2,"increasedamagegiven":6,"decreasedamagetaken":2}},{"ids":["01","02","04","06"],"bonuses":{"damage":3,"increasedamagegiven":4,"decreasedamagetaken":2}},{"ids":["01","02","06","07"],"bonuses":{"damage":3,"increasedamagegiven":2,"decreasedamagetaken":5}},{"ids":["01","04","05","06"],"bonuses":{"damage":1,"increasedamagegiven":6,"decreasedamagetaken":4}},{"ids":["01","04","06","07"],"bonuses":{"damage":1,"increasedamagegiven":4,"decreasedamagetaken":5}},{"ids":["01","06","07","08"],"bonuses":{"damage":1,"increasedamagegiven":4,"decreasedamagetaken":10}}]}

g.text: Draft 1 / Musashi Ken classification / forked tree · Foundations support. Hidden Arts focus. Advanced Arts define.
1 BP each · Acquire points with silver
Every Musashi Ken jutsu: existing supported tags qualify; combat scope stays unchanged.
Finish a path in 3 purchases. Spend your fourth on support or a sibling Hidden Art.
Any two Advanced Arts require at least 5 points. Your limit is 4.
Each skill purchased once · Only your current bloodline unlocks · No converging paths
Examples are choices, not locked presets. Advanced Arts are optional.
Cut of No Return path + Reading the Field
Two Heavens as One path + Reading the Field
Victory in the Sheath path + Drawn Steel
IDG: Increase Damage Given · DDT: Decrease Damage Taken
Jutsu level 25 · main-tree bonuses and bloodline passives excluded
Static bonuses: a 35% tag with +5% becomes 40%. A 40 EP jutsu with +5 Damage becomes 45EP.
Proposed whole-kit potency classification. Current effect-element matching alone does not provide this inheritance.
8 legal four-skill allocations · 3 Advanced Arts available · Combat tuning remains experimental
